1	```markdown
2	# PalettePulse – Setup Guide
3	Light-weight color-palette generation powered by sensor fusion.
4	
5	> This document walks you through cloning, building, and running the **PalettePulse**
6	> core library and its companion demo application (iOS / Android).  
7	> The guide assumes **macOS 13+** or **Ubuntu 22.04 LTS**.  
8	> For Windows users, most steps are identical when using **WSL 2**.
9	
10	---
11	
12	## Table of Contents
13	1. Prerequisites
14	2. Repository Layout
15	3. Quick Start (One-liner)
16	4. Detailed Build Instructions  
17	   4.1 Bootstrap Script  
18	   4.2 CMake Options  
19	   4.3 iOS Build  
20	   4.4 Android Build  
21	5. Running Tests
22	6. Code Quality & Tooling
23	7. Runtime Environment
24	8. FAQ
25	
26	---
27	
28	## 1. Prerequisites
29	
30	| Tool                | macOS (brew)                   | Ubuntu (apt)              | Notes                             |
31	|---------------------|--------------------------------|---------------------------|-----------------------------------|
32	| CMake ≥ 3.24        | `brew install cmake`           | `sudo apt install cmake`  | Ninja is auto-downloaded          |
33	| Clang ≥ 14          | Xcode Command Line Tools       | `sudo apt install clang`  | GCC works but Clang is preferred  |
34	| vcpkg               | `brew install vcpkg`           | — *(manual, see below)*   | Dependency manager                |
35	| Python ≥ 3.10       | included                       | `sudo apt install python3`| For helper scripts & hooks        |
36	| OpenSSL dev         | `brew install openssl@3`       | `sudo apt install libssl-dev` | Encryption layer            |
37	| iOS Toolchain       | Xcode 14                       | —                         | Required only for iOS builds      |
38	| Android NDK r26     | Installed via Android Studio   | Manual *(see script)*     | Required only for Android builds  |
39	
40	> ℹ️ **vcpkg** is used *only* for the desktop simulator build; mobile builds rely on
41	> platform SDKs.
42	
43	---
44	
45	## 2. Repository Layout
46	
47	```
48	PalettePulse/
49	 ├─ CMakeLists.txt
50	 ├─ cmake/
51	 ├─ docs/
52	 ├─ src/                # Cross-platform C++17 core
53	 ├─ platforms/
54	 │   ├─ ios/
55	 │   └─ android/
56	 ├─ scripts/
57	 ├─ tests/
58	 └─ third_party/        # Vendored libs (header-only or with license)
59	```
60	
61	---
62	
63	## 3. Quick Start (One-liner)
64	
65	```bash
66	# Clone including submodules and bootstrap everything.
67	git clone --recursive https://github.com/YourOrg/PalettePulse.git
68	cd PalettePulse
69	./scripts/bootstrap.sh && ./scripts/build_desktop.sh
70	```
71	
72	> After the build completes, run the event-simulator demo:
73	
74	```bash
75	./build/desktop/PalettePulseDemo
76	```
77	
78	---
79	
80	## 4. Detailed Build Instructions
81	
82	### 4.1 Bootstrap Script
83	
84	`scripts/bootstrap.sh` installs vcpkg (if missing), fetches dependencies, and
85	configures Git hooks. You can tweak the dependency list via
86	`scripts/vcpkg.json`.
87	
88	```bash
89	chmod +x scripts/bootstrap.sh
90	./scripts/bootstrap.sh     # --dry-run to preview actions
91	```
92	
93	### 4.2 CMake Options
94	
95	| Option                         | Default | Description                                   |
96	|--------------------------------|---------|-----------------------------------------------|
97	| `PULSE_BUILD_DEMO`             | `ON`    | Build desktop demo                            |
98	| `PULSE_ENABLE_LTO`             | `ON`    | Enable Link-Time Optimization                 |
99	| `PULSE_ENABLE_SANITIZERS`      | `OFF`   | Address/UB sanitizers (debug only)            |
100	| `PULSE_MOBILE_PLATFORM`        | `""`    | `ios` or `android` for cross-compilation      |
101	| `PULSE_ENABLE_BIOMETRIC_AUTH`  | `ON`    | Toggle biometric feature stub in simulator    |
102	
103	Example custom build (macOS desktop with sanitizers):
104	
105	```bash
106	cmake -S . -B build \
107	      -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug \
108	      -DPULSE_ENABLE_SANITIZERS=ON
109	cmake --build build -j$(sysctl -n hw.logicalcpu)
110	```
111	
112	### 4.3 iOS Build
113	
114	```bash
115	# 1. Generate Xcode workspace
116	cmake -S . -B build/ios \
117	      -DPULSE_MOBILE_PLATFORM=ios \
118	      -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=platforms/ios/ios.toolchain.cmake
119	
120	# 2. Open in Xcode
121	open build/ios/PalettePulse.xcodeproj
122	# (Or build via command line)
123	cmake --build build/ios --target PalettePulseApp --config Release
124	```
125	
126	The resulting `.app` can be installed via Xcode or `ideviceinstaller`.
127	
128	### 4.4 Android Build
129	
130	```bash
131	export ANDROID_NDK_HOME=$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/ndk/26.1.10909125  # adjust
132	cmake -S . -B build/android \
133	      -DPULSE_MOBILE_PLATFORM=android \
134	      -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=$ANDROID_NDK_HOME/build/cmake/android.toolchain.cmake \
135	      -DANDROID_ABI=arm64-v8a -DANDROID_NATIVE_API_LEVEL=29
136	
137	cmake --build build/android --target PalettePulseAPK -- -j8
138	```
139	
140	The APK is placed under `build/android/outputs/apk/`.
141	
142	---
143	
144	## 5. Running Tests
145	
146	All unit & integration tests live in `tests/` and use **Catch2**.
147	
148	```bash
149	cmake --build build --target test       # alias for `ctest --output-on-failure`
150	```
151	
152	Individual suites:
153	
154	```bash
155	./build/tests/EventBusTests "[EventBus]"
156	./build/tests/StorageTests   "[Storage]"
157	```
158	
159	---
160	
161	## 6. Code Quality & Tooling
162	
163	| Tool             | Invocation                              | Purpose                          |
164	|------------------|-----------------------------------------|----------------------------------|
165	| `clang-format`   | `./scripts/format.sh`                   | Enforce style (Google + tweaks)  |
166	| `clang-tidy`     | `cmake --build build --target tidy`     | Static analysis                  |
167	| `cppcheck`       | `./scripts/static_analysis.sh`          | Additional diagnostics           |
168	| `include-what-you-use` | `./scripts/iwyu.sh`               | Header hygiene                   |
169	| `pre-commit`     | auto-installed in hooks                 | Runs all of the above on commit  |
170	
171	---
172	
173	## 7. Runtime Environment
174	
175	The app looks for a few environment variables; defaults are safe for dev.
176	
177	```bash
178	# Optional; otherwise the sandbox keychain is used.
179	export PULSE_STORAGE_KEY="local-test-secret"
180	
181	# Custom backend (defaults to staging)
182	export PULSE_CLOUD_ENDPOINT="https://api.dev.palettepulse.com"
183	```
184	
185	On iOS/Android, these are injected via `Info.plist` and `gradle.properties`
186	respectively.
187	
188	---
189	
190	## 8. FAQ
191	
192	**Q: Build fails with *undefined symbol: _objc_class_...* on macOS Monterey**  
193	A: Ensure Xcode 14+ is selected: `sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode.app`
194	
195	**Q: Can I swap vcpkg for Conan?**  
196	A: Yes. Set `-DPULSE_PACKAGE_MANAGER=conan` and run `scripts/conan_setup.py`.
197	
198	**Q: Where are premium feature toggles?**  
199	A: `src/monetization/InAppPurchaseGateway.cpp` – compile-time flags gate code
200	until the entitlement server responds.
201	
202	---
203	
204	## Appendix – Minimal Event Bus Example
205	
206	```cpp
207	// src/examples/min_event_bus.cpp
208	#include <pulse/core/EventBus.hpp>
209	#include <pulse/core/events/CreativeEvent.hpp>
210	#include <pulse/core/palette/PaletteService.hpp>
211	
212	using namespace pulse;
213	
214	int main() {
215	    EventBus bus;
216	
217	    PaletteService service(bus);            // Observes CreativeEvents
218	    bus.post(CreativeEvent::HueDetected{0xFF3366});
219	
220	    bus.flush();                            // Process queued events
221	    return 0;
222	}
223	```
224	
225	Compile & run:
226	
227	```bash
228	c++ -std=c++20 -Iinclude -o min_event_bus src/examples/min_event_bus.cpp
229	./min_event_bus
230	```
231	
232	---
233	
234	Happy hacking!  
235	— The PalettePulse Team
236	```
